## Statement

Published source maps restore enough structure to recover all endpoints.

## Verification Criterion

Endpoint recall via maps alone >= 90%.

## Experiment Notes

Most production bundles ship without maps or with stripped maps.

## Result

**Finding:** Only 18% of benchmark bundles shipped usable source maps.
